maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring IoT connectivity subscriptions and platform services for new deployments, not repair or maintenance of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private enterprises (retailers, fleet operators, healthcare device makers, industrial firms) paying for IoT connectivity.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling IoT connectivity and managed services; past acquisitions were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded SIMs, connectivity platform ConnectivityPro and certified devices make switching costly; patient-critical and fleet devices need uptime.
